Ilara-Mokin.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine

Ilara-Mokin.fact: The "mokin" part of Ilara-Mokin, or mọ ọ̀kín, means "the ones who know the ọ̀kín bird." The phrase was later contracted to " Ìlárá-Mọ̀kín," or "Ùlárá-Mọ̀kín."
